editions.headline: Sales are absorbing the shock. Prices have stopped rising.
editions.keyLine: New Brunswick home sales in 2026, on current tracking. Forecasts published a year ago called for a gain of 4% to 7%.
points: 7,790 homes sold in the first ten months, 6.8% fewer than in 2025.
The benchmark price was $339,400 in October: 1.2% above a year earlier and 3.6% below May.
None of the New Brunswick forecasts issued before April 2026 scored above a simple no-change assumption. Grades are provisional until year-end data is in.
Our outlook for the next 12 months: benchmark price −2% to +1%, with 2027 sales of 8,900 to 9,300 units.
